name: Mehdi Cherti
bio: Mehdi Cherti is a researcher at the Jülich Supercomputing Centre and a LAION co-founder. Cherti is first author of Reproducible Scaling Laws for Contrastive Language-Image Learning (CVPR 2023), which trained OpenCLIP models on LAION data up to two billion image-text pairs and released the models and evaluation workflow.
known_for: First author of the OpenCLIP scaling laws paper
Open CLIP models trained on LAION data
